document.abstract: A discussion of experimental work now being carried on at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology on a program of visual education designed to facilitate teaching in the fields of science and engineering. The use of animation and the technic of its application in the first of a series of films showing the behavior of an electrical wave travelling along a 250-mile power transmission line, are described. Other films are considered and the possibilities of animation in other fields of technical training are indicated.
